001package com.streamConverter.command.impl;
002
003import com.streamConverter.command.AbstractStreamCommand;
004import com.streamConverter.command.rule.IRule;
005import com.streamConverter.command.rule.PassThroughRule;
006import com.streamConverter.pathHandler.FixedStaXPathHandler;
007import java.io.IOException;
008import java.io.InputStream;
009import java.io.OutputStream;
010import java.io.OutputStreamWriter;
011import java.io.Writer;
012import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;
013import java.util.ArrayList;
014import java.util.List;
015import java.util.logging.Logger;
016import javax.xml.stream.XMLEventFactory;
017import javax.xml.stream.XMLEventReader;
018import javax.xml.stream.XMLEventWriter;
019import javax.xml.stream.XMLInputFactory;
020import javax.xml.stream.XMLOutputFactory;
021import javax.xml.stream.XMLStreamException;
022import javax.xml.stream.events.XMLEvent;
023
024/**
025 * XML Navigate Command Class
026 *
027 * <p>This class implements command for targeted XML transformation using XPath. It identifies
028 * specific elements using XPath expressions and applies IRule transformations to those elements
029 * while preserving the overall XML structure.
030 */
031public class XmlNavigateCommand extends AbstractStreamCommand {
032  private static final Logger LOGGER = Logger.getLogger(XmlNavigateCommand.class.getName());
033  private static final XMLEventFactory EVENT_FACTORY = XMLEventFactory.newInstance();
034
035  private String xpath;
036  private IRule rule;
037  private FixedStaXPathHandler pathHandler;
038
039  /**
040   * Constructor for XML navigation with XPath selector and transformation rule.
041   *
042   * @param xpath the XPath expression to select elements (e.g., "users/user/name")
043   * @param rule the transformation rule to apply to selected elements
044   * @throws IllegalArgumentException if rule is null
045   */
046  public XmlNavigateCommand(String xpath, IRule rule) {
047    if (rule == null) {
048      throw new IllegalArgumentException("Rule cannot be null");
049    }
050    this.xpath = xpath;
051    this.rule = rule;
052    if (xpath != null) {
053      this.pathHandler = new FixedStaXPathHandler(xpath);
054    }
055  }
056
057  /**
058   * Constructor for XML navigation with XPath selector using PassThroughRule.
059   *
060   * @param xpath the XPath expression to select elements (e.g., "users/user/name")
061   * @deprecated This constructor uses PassThroughRule by default, which may not be the intended
062   *     behavior. Use {@link #XmlNavigateCommand(String, IRule)} to explicitly specify the
063   *     transformation rule. For data extraction without transformation, use {@link
064   *     #extractOnly(String)}.
065   */
066  @Deprecated(since = "1.2.0", forRemoval = true)
067  public XmlNavigateCommand(String xpath) {
068    this(xpath, new PassThroughRule());
069  }
070
071  /**
072   * Default constructor - processes entire XML with PassThroughRule.
073   *
074   * @deprecated This constructor uses PassThroughRule by default, which may not be the intended
075   *     behavior. Use {@link #XmlNavigateCommand(String, IRule)} to explicitly specify the
076   *     transformation rule. For data extraction without transformation, use {@link #extractAll()}.
077   */
078  @Deprecated(since = "1.2.0", forRemoval = true)
079  public XmlNavigateCommand() {
080    this(null, new PassThroughRule());
081  }
082
083  /**
084   * Factory method for creating an XML navigation command that extracts data without
085   * transformation. This method makes the intention explicit: extract data from the specified XPath
086   * as-is.
087   *
088   * @param xpath the XPath expression to select elements (e.g., "users/user/name")
089   * @return an XmlNavigateCommand that extracts the specified XPath without transformation
090   */
091  public static XmlNavigateCommand extractOnly(String xpath) {
092    return new XmlNavigateCommand(xpath, new PassThroughRule());
093  }
094
095  /**
096   * Factory method for creating an XML navigation command that processes entire XML without
097   * transformation. This method makes the intention explicit: process all XML data as-is.
098   *
099   * @return an XmlNavigateCommand that processes entire XML without transformation
100   */
101  public static XmlNavigateCommand extractAll() {
102    return new XmlNavigateCommand(null, new PassThroughRule());
103  }
104
105  @Override
106  protected String getCommandDetails() {
107    if (xpath != null) {
108      return String.format("XmlNavigateCommand(xpath='%s')", xpath);
109    } else {
110      return "XmlNavigateCommand(entire XML)";
111    }
112  }
113
114  @Override
115  protected void _execute(InputStream inputStream, OutputStream outputStream) throws IOException {
116    try (Writer writer = new OutputStreamWriter(outputStream, StandardCharsets.UTF_8)) {
117      if (xpath == null) {
118        // Apply rule to entire XML content
119        applyRuleToEntireXml(inputStream, writer);
120      } else {
121        // Apply rule to specific XPath elements while preserving structure
122        applyRuleToXmlPath(inputStream, writer);
123      }
124    } catch (XMLStreamException e) {
125      throw new IOException("XML processing error", e);
126    }
127  }
128
129  /** Apply transformation rule to entire XML content */
130  private void applyRuleToEntireXml(InputStream inputStream, Writer writer)
131      throws IOException, XMLStreamException {
132    XMLEventReader eventReader = null;
133    XMLEventWriter eventWriter = null;
134
135    try {
136      eventReader = createXMLEventReader(inputStream);
137      eventWriter = createXMLEventWriter(writer);
138      processXmlEvents(eventReader, eventWriter, (event, data) -> rule.apply(data));
139    } catch (XMLStreamException e) {
140      handleXmlException(e);
141    } finally {
142      closeResources(eventReader, eventWriter);
143    }
144  }
145
146  /**
147   * Apply transformation rule to specific XPath elements while preserving XML structure This is a
148   * simplified implementation - production version would need proper XPath library
149   */
150  private void applyRuleToXmlPath(InputStream inputStream, Writer writer)
151      throws IOException, XMLStreamException {
152    XMLEventReader eventReader = null;
153    XMLEventWriter eventWriter = null;
154
155    try {
156      eventReader = createXMLEventReader(inputStream);
157      eventWriter = createXMLEventWriter(writer);
158      navigateXmlWithRule(eventReader, eventWriter, pathHandler, rule);
159    } catch (XMLStreamException e) {
160      handleXmlException(e);
161    } finally {
162      closeResources(eventReader, eventWriter);
163    }
164  }
165
166  private void navigateXmlWithRule(
167      XMLEventReader eventReader,
168      XMLEventWriter eventWriter,
169      FixedStaXPathHandler pathHandler,
170      IRule rule)
171      throws XMLStreamException {
172    List<String> currentPath = new ArrayList<>();
173    boolean inTargetElement = false;
174    int targetDepth = 0;
175
176    while (eventReader.hasNext()) {
177      XMLEvent event = eventReader.nextEvent();
178
179      if (event.isStartElement()) {
180        String elementName = event.asStartElement().getName().getLocalPart();
181        currentPath.add(elementName);
182
183        if (pathHandler.isTarget(currentPath)) {
184          inTargetElement = true;
185          targetDepth = currentPath.size();
186          eventWriter.add(event);
187        } else if (inTargetElement) {
188          eventWriter.add(event);
189        }
190      } else if (event.isEndElement()) {
191        if (inTargetElement) {
192          eventWriter.add(event);
193          if (currentPath.size() == targetDepth) {
194            inTargetElement = false;
195            // Add newline as simple characters
196            eventWriter.add(EVENT_FACTORY.createCharacters("\n"));
197          }
198        }
199        currentPath.remove(currentPath.size() - 1);
200      } else if (event.isCharacters() && inTargetElement) {
201        // Apply rule to character data in target elements
202        String originalData = event.asCharacters().getData();
203        String transformedData = rule.apply(originalData);
204        if (!originalData.equals(transformedData)) {
205          // Create new character event with transformed data
206          XMLEvent transformedEvent = EVENT_FACTORY.createCharacters(transformedData);
207          eventWriter.add(transformedEvent);
208        } else {
209          eventWriter.add(event);
210        }
211      }
212    }
213  }
214
215  // Common factory methods and utilities
216  private XMLEventReader createXMLEventReader(InputStream inputStream) throws XMLStreamException {
217    XMLInputFactory inputFactory = XMLInputFactory.newInstance();
218    XMLEventReader reader = inputFactory.createXMLEventReader(inputStream);
219    if (!reader.hasNext()) {
220      throw new XMLStreamException("Empty XML input");
221    }
222    return reader;
223  }
224
225  private XMLEventWriter createXMLEventWriter(Writer writer) throws XMLStreamException {
226    XMLOutputFactory outputFactory = XMLOutputFactory.newInstance();
227    return outputFactory.createXMLEventWriter(writer);
228  }
229
230  private void handleXmlException(XMLStreamException e) throws IOException {
231    String message = e.getMessage();
232    if (message != null && (message.contains("unclosed") || message.contains("end"))) {
233      throw new IOException("Invalid XML format - unclosed tags", e);
234    }
235    throw new IOException("Invalid XML format", e);
236  }
237
238  @FunctionalInterface
239  private interface CharacterDataProcessor {
240    String process(XMLEvent event, String data);
241  }
242
243  private void processXmlEvents(
244      XMLEventReader eventReader, XMLEventWriter eventWriter, CharacterDataProcessor processor)
245      throws XMLStreamException {
246    while (eventReader.hasNext()) {
247      XMLEvent event = eventReader.nextEvent();
248
249      if (event.isCharacters()) {
250        String originalData = event.asCharacters().getData();
251        String transformedData = processor.process(event, originalData);
252
253        if (!originalData.equals(transformedData)) {
254          XMLEvent transformedEvent = EVENT_FACTORY.createCharacters(transformedData);
255          eventWriter.add(transformedEvent);
256        } else {
257          eventWriter.add(event);
258        }
259      } else {
260        eventWriter.add(event);
261      }
262    }
263    eventWriter.flush();
264  }
265
266  private void closeResources(XMLEventReader eventReader, XMLEventWriter eventWriter) {
267    if (eventReader != null) {
268      try {
269        eventReader.close();
270      } catch (XMLStreamException e) {
271        LOGGER.warning("Failed to close XMLEventReader: " + e.getMessage());
272      }
273    }
274    if (eventWriter != null) {
275      try {
276        eventWriter.close();
277      } catch (XMLStreamException e) {
278        LOGGER.warning("Failed to close XMLEventWriter: " + e.getMessage());
279      }
280    }
281  }
282}
